lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Semi-regular distribution of high-luminance circular blobs posterior to the gills, organized into roughly vertical columns and horizontal rows.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of higher pixel intensity intersecting with circular blobs, creating a localized grid-like anchor node structure on the lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Horizontal linear feature on the upper third of the flank characterized by a high-contrast light-to-shadow gradient.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Distribution of circular high-luminance spots across the visible surface of the first dorsal fin.
